t: This Sylvania Toledo E27 GLS LED light bulb provides an energy-efficient and long-lasting lighting solution for various applications. Featuring a frosted finish, it delivers 806 lumens of uniform illumination, making it ideal for general purpose lighting in workshops, storerooms, and commercial environments. Consuming only 7 watts, this LED bulb offers significant energy savings compared to traditional options and boasts a 15,000-hour average rated life, reducing maintenance. With instant light at the flick of a switch and good colour rendering (CRI 80), it ensures clear visibility and accurate colour perception.
